intro: The Mage is Guildrun's Magic class: back-line casters that deal damage and disrupt enemies with powerful active abilities. Mages scale Magic and lean on Stall, Burn, and Frost — their casts detonate packs and stack damage-over-time when the fight lasts. In Demo 0.5.3 they are the highest AoE ceiling in the game, but every Mage lives or dies by cast geometry: a spell that misses the pack or a caster that dies mid-channel is a wasted turn. Build Mages when Magic, Stall, and Elemental banners keep appearing and you can protect the back row.
seoDescription: Guildrun Mage class guide: Magic back-line casters scaling Stall, Burn, and Frost. Best Mage heroes, relics, positioning, and comp tips.
roleLabel: Back-line Magic caster — Stall / Burn / Frost AoE
strength: Massive area payoff: Mage casts hit whole packs and scale with Stall-driven permanent Magic
weakness: Positioning-dependent and fragile — a missed cast or an opened-on Mage loses the fight

howToPlay.draft: Draft a Mage only with a front line to protect it. Rank B toward Stall snowball (permanent Magic, longer casts) or tribal Debuff paths if you run multiple Mages. Aim casts before adding more Magic.
howToPlay.shop: Stall enablers and Mage banners (Enlightenment / Elemental) first — Stall triggers permanent Magic. Then Mana / cast uptime, then raw Magic amplifiers.
howToPlay.positioning: Back row aimed down the main lane so casts cover where packs actually stand. Re-angle after every loss; never leave a Mage on a dive tile.

shopPriorities: Stall enablers so Mage abilities grow permanent Magic
Mage banners (Enlightenment for Magic, Elemental for Burn/Frost)
Mana / cast uptime pieces to guarantee casts land
Magic amplifiers last, once geometry and uptime are solved

signatureHeroes.name: Funke
signatureHeroes.why: Area Burn Mage whose Wildfire cooks every enemy in range at once.

signatureHeroes.name: Ratna
signatureHeroes.why: Burst nuke Mage for single big-cast payoffs.

signatureHeroes.name: Sal

faq.question: What is the Mage class in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Mages are a Magic-based back-line class that deals damage and disrupts enemies with active abilities, scaling Stall, Burn, and Frost. Their casts hit whole packs and grow with Stall-driven permanent Magic.

faq.question: What are the best Mage heroes in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Aria (dual Burn/Frost channel carry), Funke (area Burn), Ratna (burst nuke), and Sal (short-range Frost support) are the standout Mage picks.

faq.question: What relics work with Mages?
faq.answer: Stall enablers and Mage banners (Enlightenment, Elemental) first, then Mana/cast uptime, then raw Magic amplifiers. Stall triggers permanent Magic, so it comes before flat damage.

faq.question: Why does my Mage feel weak?
faq.answer: Usually a geometry problem: the cast isn't hitting the pack, or the Mage dies before casting. Fix aim and add a front line before buying more Magic relics.

tips: After every loss ask: did the cast hit the pack? Move the Mage or the tank before rerolling relics.
A Stall-scaling Mage without Stall sources is half-powered — add Stall enablers or switch the Rank B path.
